title.en: the lights on bourbon street, second line in the sky.
title.de: die lichter der bourbon street, second line in the sky.
title.tr: bourbon street'in ışıkları, second line in the sky.

line.en: the light installation over the 100 to 300 blocks of the french quarter returns today and runs to 3 jan. go after dark, the lights are the point.
line.de: die lichtinstallation über den blöcken 100 bis 300 im french quarter kehrt heute zurück und läuft bis 3. januar. geh nach einbruch der dunkelheit, die lichter sind der punkt.
line.tr: french quarter'ın 100 ila 300. blokları üzerindeki ışık düzeni bugün geri dönüyor ve 3 ocak'a kadar sürüyor. karanlıkta git, asıl mesele ışıklar.

sparks.why: Second Line in the Sky returns to Bourbon Street on 23 november 2026 through 3 january 2027 (neworleans.com press release); the start hour is not confirmed, 18:00 is a suggested evening start.
